summary: Verified frontend now points exclusively to https://lex-kasa.onrender.com. Across two end-to-end Playwright sessions (64 total /api/* requests captured), 0 calls hit the old emergentagent.com backend. Login, dashboard (4 kasa cards), navigation to Müvekkil/Masraflar/Vekalet Alacakları/Raporlar/İşlem Günlüğü, client creation (POST /api/clients 200), kasa rename (PATCH /api/kasalar/{id} 200), kasa transfer modal, reports summary, transactions fetch, and logout -> re-login all worked. Persistence confirmed: TEST_Muvekkil_38019 remained in the list after logout+re-login (proves MongoDB Atlas on Render is backing the data). Render cold-start first request took ~5s, subsequent were fast.
critical_code_review_comments: Env change is minimal and correct; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is read via api.js and used consistently.
Confirmed CORS from Render allows the preview origin (preflight OPTIONS not needed as GET/POST with Bearer token succeeded).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test client 'TEST_Muvekkil_38019' and renamed Merkez Ofis Kasası (name suffixed with timestamp). These persist in Atlas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://lex-kasa.onrender.com. All /api/* requests were verified to hit Render only. Test leftover data in Atlas: TEST_Muvekkil_38019 client and the renamed Merkez kasa — main agent may want to rename the kasa back if needed.
